text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2023.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2023

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua puluh enam juta

enam puluh enam ribu ringgit (RM26,066,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2023 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 3,645,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 12,579,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 368,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,044,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 8,430,000

JUMLAH 26,066,000

Dibuat 30 Julai 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(11); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2023

IN excercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1)

of the Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2023.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2023

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding twenty six million sixty-six thousand

ringgit (RM26,066,000) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme

for the year 2023 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 3,645,000

Supplies and services 12,579,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 368,000

Other expenditures 1,044,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 8,430,000

TOTAL 26,066,000

Made 30 July 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(11); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

 Minister of Human Resources
